fact: On Monday 10 August 2026 the interior minister, Saïd Sayoud, chaired a review of the sector's digitisation covering civil-status documents, at which shortcomings and malfunctions liable to affect the continuity and quality of services were diagnosed and firm instructions given to treat them at once; the article says the digitisation of civil status continues to stumble on fitting the new competences transferred to civil-status officers to the old administrative circuit.
title: Numérisation de l'état civil : Sayoud hausse le ton face aux « insuffisances »
